title: Michael wonders who built the pyramids and the English standing stones

tellings.quote: How this stone got here in England? Them them them stones. Who who did this?

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael, who says he was abducted by aliens, wonders aloud who built the Egyptian pyramids and how the great standing stones of England got where they are. He asks this during a reunion with fellow veterans on Michels' show, as someone who suspects people alone may not have done it.
